title: You can write your own lyrics

body.text: you can type your own lyrics fully, and use
to tell Suno which part is which — like [Verse], [Chorus], [Bridge], [Outro]. Suno composes a melody to fit each section, giving the song a clear structure like a real song.

example:
[Verse]
The first light of day shines in
[Chorus]
Stand up and fight on together

title: Let AI help write the lyrics

body.text: If you're stuck on lyrics, use ChatGPT or Claude to draft them first — give the theme, mood, and number of sections, then paste the lyrics into Suno. The trick is to ask for

example: Help write Thai lyrics on the theme of friendship — 1 Verse and 1 Chorus, rhyming with a catchy hook
